referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The unit process inventory takes into account the production of ammonium nitrate from ammonia and nitric acid. Transports of the intermediate products to the fertiliser plant as well as the transport of the fertiliser product from the factory to the regional storehouse are included. Production and waste treatment of catalysts, coating and packaging of the final fertiliser products were not included. Infrastructure was included by means of a proxy module.

geography.text: According to the reference used for this inventory, the European average is derived from mean values of several fertiliser plants within Europe. The production of raw materials and/or intermediates outside Europe was taken into account by considering the production technology in the respective country and the relative import shares.

technology.text: Production inventory was derived from detailed literature studies and specifications from the manufacturer, relevant for the European production. Transport specifications of the fertiliser product to the regional department store, which were not included in the reference used for this inventory, were complemented by data given in Patyk & Reinhardt (1997).

timePeriod.text: Year when the principal reference used for this inventory was published.

representativeness.extrapolations: No extrapolations done for inputs, emissions partly extrapolated from emission factors originating from plants in selected European countries.
representativeness.productionVolume: 2543287 tons N in 1999 in 13 European countries
representativeness.samplingProcedure: Values given in the reference originate from manufacturers and/or other data sources which in turn refer to the real situation and hence are largely secured. However, the emissions factors may be somewhat uncertain. When no information on the speciation of N - emissions was given in the reference, the most likely speciation was assessed by an expert. For particulate emissions factors into the air specified only as the total particle mass in the reference, particle size distribution was assessed based on an expert's guess.
